content_units: Best Osaka Rentals for an Umeda Commute

You want the best two options under a   JPY 115,000 monthly cap  , with   commute under 30 minutes  , and a   strong preference for separate bath and toilet  . Based on those priorities, the top two picks are   Nakazakicho 1DK   and   Fukushima 1DK  .
Ranked Apartment Comparison
Option   Total Monthly Cost   Commute to Umeda   Layout / Size   Bath / Toilet   Building Notes   Fit for Your Priorities
Nakazakicho 1DK     JPY 106,000       12 min     1DK / 27 sqm     Separate     2nd floor, no elevator     Best value balance
Fukushima 1DK     JPY 114,000       9 min     1DK / 29 sqm     Separate     8th floor, elevator     Best convenience pick
Juso 1K   JPY 82,000   18 min   1K / 24 sqm   Combined   5th floor, elevator   Cheap, but misses key bathroom preference
Tennoji 1LDK   JPY 125,000   26 min   1LDK / 35 sqm   Separate   6th floor, elevator   Over budget
Why These Two Stand Out
Option 1: Nakazakicho 1DK
-   Best overall match   for your budget and bathroom preference.
- Total monthly cost is   JPY 106,000  , which leaves some room under your cap.
-   12-minute commute   is comfortably within target and practical for daily travel.
-   1DK and 27 sqm   gives better livability than a tight 1K.
Compromise
- The main drawback is   no elevator   on the   2nd floor  .
- Since it is only the 2nd floor, this is a relatively small compromise compared with giving up a separate bath/toilet.
Option 2: Fukushima 1DK
-   Best premium option within budget  .
- Total monthly cost is   JPY 114,000  , which is just under your   JPY 115,000   limit.
-   9-minute commute   is the fastest of all listings.
-   Separate bath/toilet  ,   29 sqm  , and   elevator access   make it the most comfortable day-to-day choice among eligible units.
Compromise
- Very little budget flexibility: you are only   JPY 1,000 under budget  .
- If you want to keep room for utilities, internet, or move-in-related monthly variability, this option is tighter financially than Nakazakicho.
Why the Other Two Are Not Recommended
Juso 1K
- The rent is attractive at   JPY 82,000 total  , and the   18-minute commute   is acceptable.
- However, it has a   combined bath/toilet  , which directly conflicts with your strongest stated preference.
- It only becomes a good backup if saving money matters more than bathroom layout.
Tennoji 1LDK
- Good size, separate bath/toilet, and commute still under 30 minutes.
- But total monthly cost is   JPY 125,000  , which is   over your budget  .
- Because budget is a hard constraint, it should be excluded despite the larger layout.
Final Recommendation
Best value choice:     Nakazakicho 1DK
- Best balance of affordability, commute, and preferred bathroom setup.
Best comfort/convenience choice:     Fukushima 1DK
- Best overall living quality within budget, but only barely under your cap.
